# Tejaswini Industries

Tejaswini Industries manufactures distribution transformers, power transformers, dry-type transformers, HT panels, LT panels and ring main units in Mallapur, Hyderabad, Telangana, India.

The published distribution range is 100 kVA to 5000 kVA at 11 kV, 22 kV and 33 kV, with ONAN (oil-cooled) cooling and off-load or on-load tap changers. A second sentence on the distribution page also says capacity up to 10000 kVA. Power-transformer copy describes copper foil winding and units up to 63 MVA, 132 kV class. Dry-type units are VPI up to 2.5 MVA. The site shows ISO 9001:2015 and BIS Certified marks and says products are IS/IEC compliant. It does not publish certificate numbers, an aluminium-winding specification, amorphous-core or CRGO ratings, a lead time, or a TSSPDCL product approval. TGSPDCL / TSSPDCL liaisoning is listed as a service.
